objective: Complete the fixed N-day conversion-window temporal contract by excluding economics and durable outcome evidence that occurred before the relationship itself was created.
evidence: Insurance fact constructors validate their own occurredAt but do not receive the CRM relationship createdAt.
D1 economics and outcome append paths do not read the CRM relationship createdAt before insertion.
Migrations 0006 and 0007 enforce relationship identity but no cross-table createdAt/occurredAt temporal invariant.
Therefore INS-004O must own the lower-inclusive relationship-created boundary for fixed-window reporting.
rules: Evidence occurring before relationship.createdAt is excluded from fixed-window reporting.
Evidence occurring exactly at relationship.createdAt is included.
Existing per-relationship upper-exclusive window semantics remain unchanged.
Existing reporting asOfExclusive upper bound remains unchanged.
The shared filter implementation applies the same lower-inclusive boundary to acquisition cost, premium, commission, renewal, and durable outcome facts.
No fact constructor, D1 persistence owner, migration, global as-of owner, aggregation owner, dashboard, deployment, or telephony behavior is changed.
